title: Enterprise deployment hardening
goal: Make production deployment requirements explicit and verifiable for enterprise environments instead of leaving them as implicit host knowledge.
scope: Add production deployment hardening checks and documentation for TLS/reverse proxy, trusted certificates, secure cookies, proxy egress controls, no-internet/air-gapped operation, offline tool/feed update paths, secure default warnings, database encryption state, artifact storage encryption, and production-vs-development mode differences. Surface unsupported/degraded deployment states in Settings/Diagnostics without blocking local development.
generation_reason: AegisPT targets enterprise/MKB use, but enterprise deployment requires production-grade TLS, proxy, offline, certificate, encryption, and update posture checks. Existing install and DB encryption tasks cover pieces, not a single production hardening readiness gate.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Deployment hardening and readiness surfacing only. Do not add hosted SaaS, billing, or external telemetry.

success_criteria: Production install docs state mandatory TLS/reverse-proxy/certificate requirements.
Settings/Diagnostics shows production hardening status for TLS assumptions, database encryption, artifact storage, proxy/offline mode, and update/feed constraints.
Air-gapped/offline operation has an explicit support statement and manual update path for feeds/tools/templates.
Secure cookie/session and public-base-url warnings are visible when production settings are unsafe.
Validation includes local development mode and simulated production configuration checks.
No production secret or certificate material is printed in logs or UI.

acceptance_criteria: An operator can tell whether the deployment is development-grade or production-hardened.
Offline/proxy/TLS/certificate limitations are explicit before enterprise rollout.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the only active task.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
